title: BatchOps
description: INPUT of `dmtool batch <ops.json>` — a JSON array of verb invocations run in one process (stateless per-op dispatch; never rolls back). Each op's result echoes its `id`/`verb`/`args` so diagnostics are never mis-attributed. Distinct from `apply` ({target,op,…} ordered surgery on one model with one terminal gate + rollback — see `schema apply`).

verb.description: the verb to run (any except `batch`, which cannot nest)

args.description: the verb's argv (as on the command line, minus the verb)

id.description: optional caller tag, echoed back on the result for correlation
